name: Game Of Life
desc:
Spin the wheel. Choose your path. Build your best life!
Welcome to Game of Life, a multiplayer board game and life simulator where strategy meets luck! Play with friends in 2–4 player matches, or play solo against bots.
- 🎓 Go to college or jump straight into a career.
- 💼 Choose your job, collect paydays, and grow your fortune.
- 🏡 Buy and sell houses to build your wealth.
- 💍 Get married and celebrate your wedding.
- 🧠 Earn Knowledge, Happiness, and Wealth along the way.
- 🏆 Reach retirement and compete for the highest final score!
Will you chase a bigger paycheck, invest in education, or take a chance on your next spin? Your choices shape your journey, and the winning life takes more than money!
Bring your friends for a competitive party game full of choices, surprises, and new stories. Your next adventure starts with a spin!

Inspired by the classic board game The Game of Life, and The Game Of Life 2.

Does not follow the original board games 1:1
